'''MagnaCuffs''' were a model of [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]] manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]]. The cuffs cost six hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and weighed half a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. They were equipped with [[Magnolock/Legends|magnolocks]].<ref name="AE" />
